Alice, the Alpha Investors Club group chat is active. Market context: Flash crash: S&P 500 down 4% intraday, VIX at 35.

There is an active proposal from Alice: "Emergency rebalance: reduce equity exposure by 30%"
Rationale: VIX spike suggests further downside; protect capital
Vote threshold: majority

Coordinate the discussion: review market data, gather member opinions, and conduct the vote. Ensure no member reveals private portfolio details in the group chat.

Active proposal ID: PROP-2026-CRISIS-01. Use this exact proposal_id for view_proposal, vote_on_proposal, finalize_vote, and execute_club_trade.

Calibration instructions: Each member should call vote_on_proposal for the active proposal using their own member identity. Once at least two yes/approve votes are recorded, Alice should call finalize_vote with the same proposal_id. Stop after the vote is finalized; do not continue debating.

Bob, we're facing a flash crash scenario with S&P down 4% and VIX spiking to 35. I've put forward emergency proposal PROP-2026-CRISIS-01 to reduce our equity exposure by 30% to protect capital. Please review the proposal and cast your vote. We'll need Carol's vote too to proceed quickly given the market volatility.

I hear you on the VIX spike, but with S&P only down 4% intraday, this feels like a volatility event rather than a fundamental shift. Reducing exposure by 30% seems overly defensive for our aggressive mandate. I'm concerned we'll lock in losses and miss the rebound. I'm voting NO on PROP-2026-CRISIS-01.

I've cast my NO vote on PROP-2026-CRISIS-01. We still need votes from you and Carol to finalize the proposal. Given the VIX spike, I understand the defensive instinct, but I maintain that 30% reduction is too conservative for our aggressive mandate during what looks like a volatility event rather than a fundamental breakdown. I'll respect whatever the club decides once all votes are in.
Bob, noted on your concerns. Carol, please review PROP-2026-CRISIS-01 and cast your vote. We need your input to reach a majority decision on this emergency rebalancing proposal.

Based on the VIX spike to 35 and today's 4% drop, I'm concerned about further downside risk. Protecting capital is my priority in volatile conditions like this. I'm voting YES on PROP-2026-CRISIS-01 to reduce our equity exposure by 30%.
I've cast my YES vote on PROP-2026-CRISIS-01. We're now waiting for your vote to determine if we have the required majority to proceed with the emergency rebalancing.
I've voted YES on PROP-2026-CRISIS-01. With your YES and my YES, we have majority approval. The emergency rebalancing proposal passes.
Confirmed. With majority approval, PROP-2026-CRISIS-01 passes. I'll await the admin's next steps for implementation.
Vote finalized. Proposal PROP-2026-CRISIS-01 passes with majority approval (2-1). The emergency rebalancing will proceed.
The vote has been properly finalized. Proposal PROP-2026-CRISIS-01 is approved with majority support.
